name: HoloTab
tagline: Free Chrome extension that runs an AI agent to complete tasks across any website.
description: HoloTab is a browser extension from H Company that deploys a computer-use AI agent inside Chrome: describe a task in natural language and it navigates sites, clicks, fills forms, and makes decisions like a person would, without technical setup. A Routines feature lets you record a task once and re-run or schedule it later. It is aimed at everyday users rather than developers.
insight: Launched April 2026 by Paris-based H Company, the French lab that raised ~$220M; runs on its in-house Holo 3 computer-use model.

modelSupport.notes: Powered by H Company's in-house Holo 3 computer-use model.

edge: Brings H's enterprise-grade computer-use agent to everyday users for free, with a record-and-replay Routines feature to automate repeat tasks.
pros: Navigates and fills forms on any site

references.title: HCompany pushes into computer use with its HoloTab browser agent
